WITH side_counts AS (
  SELECT o.dealedge, COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) as order_count
  FROM riskandmargin r
  INNER JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.dealedge
),
avg_count AS (
  SELECT AVG(order_count) as avg_count
  FROM side_counts
),
above_avg AS (
  SELECT sc.dealedge, sc.order_count, a.avg_count
  FROM side_counts sc
  CROSS JOIN avg_count a
  WHERE sc.order_count > a.avg_count
)
SELECT 
  SUM(order_count) as total_count,
  AVG(order_count - avg_count) as avg_excess
FROM above_avg
